turns.content: STOP SWIMMING AWAY, PLEASE!
I’ll stay close and pause here with you.
WAIT! DON'T GO PAST THAT REEF LEDGE.
Okay, I’ll wait on this side. Thanks for the quick warning.
The current is tugging harder there.
I’ll keep clear of the edge and move with care.
I DROPPED THE SHELL! IT'S ROLLING TOWARD THE CRACK!
I see it. I’ll nudge it away from the crack if I can.
QUICK, THE WATER IS TURNING!
I feel the flow changing. Let’s move toward the sheltered rocks.
PLEASE LISTEN NOW—THERE'S A STRONG CURRENT BEHIND YOU.
I’m listening. I’ll turn toward the calmer water.
That way, along the sand.
Got it. I’ll follow the sandy stretch slowly.
HIDE IN THE ROCKS, NOW!
I’ll stay near the rocky cover. Which spot looks sheltered?
STOP—THAT SHELL IS FRAGILE!
I’ll stop touching it. We can look without disturbing it.
BACK UP FROM THAT DRIFTING NET, PLEASE!
I’m moving away and giving it space. Thanks for spotting it.
DON'T CHASE THE BUBBLES INTO THE NARROW PASSAGE!
I’ll leave them be and stay in the open water.
HURRY, THE SAND IS SLIDING DOWN!
I’ll move away from the slope and keep to firm ground.
There’s a flat patch just over here.
Thanks. I’ll settle on that flat patch.
STOP RIGHT THERE. LOOK AT THE WATER FIRST.
Pausing to look. The water does seem busy near that gap.
WAIT UP! MY SHELL IS SNAGGED ON SEAWEED.
I’ll hold still. Can you point out where your shell is caught?
Just behind you, on the left.
Thanks for showing me. I’ll stay still while you free it gently.
I SAID THE BLUE STONE, NOT THE WHITE ONE!
You’re right; I mixed them up. I’ll look for the blue stone.
STOP INTERRUPTING ME! I AM TRYING TO EXPLAIN!
You have my attention. Go ahead; I’ll listen.
THAT IS NOT FUNNY!
I’m sorry. I’ll take your concern seriously.
YOU KEEP POINTING THE WRONG WAY!
I hear how frustrating that is. Please show me the direction once more.
Toward the kelp, not the sand.
Understood: toward the kelp. Thanks for correcting me.
BACK OFF! YOU'RE TOO CLOSE!
I’ll give you more room and stay over here.
I KNOW YOU HEARD ME!
I did hear you. I’m sorry I didn’t respond clearly.
NOW LOOK WHAT YOU DID! THE PEBBLES ARE EVERYWHERE!
That’s a mess, and I see why you’re upset. I can help gather them.
DON'T TOUCH MY LITTLE ROCK PILE!
I’ll leave your pile alone. Sorry I came too near.
WHY AREN'T YOU LISTENING TO ME?
I’m listening now. Tell me the part I missed.
I wanted to watch quietly.
I understand. I’ll be quiet and give you space.
I'M TIRED OF WAITING!
Waiting can feel long. Would you like to choose another spot to look around?
YOU MADE THE WATER ALL MUDDY!
I’m sorry the sand clouded up. I’ll stay still so it can settle.
STOP JOKING AND ANSWER THE QUESTION!
You’re right; I got sidetracked. Which question did I miss?
I FOUND A TINY TREASURE!
How exciting! What did you spot?
A shiny pebble!
What a lovely find. It catches the light beautifully.
LOOK AT ALL THOSE BUBBLES!
They’re dancing upward in a whole little parade.
THIS IS THE BEST TIDE EVER!
It does feel wonderful out here. I’m glad we get to enjoy it.
I CAN SEE THE CORAL GARDEN!
What a bright view! Let’s admire it gently from here.
HEY, OVER HERE!
I’m here. Are you calling me to show me something, or do you need a hand?
LISTEN UP!
I’m listening. Is something urgent, or would you like to tell me something exciting?
LOOK AT THIS!
I’m looking. Is it something fun, or should I be careful?
Just a funny-shaped pebble.
That is a wonderfully odd shape!
COME QUICKLY!
You sound in a hurry. What happened?
